fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so the property is visible to responding units approaching from either direction.
• Mark the entrance to the detached structure with a clearly visible label so arriving responders can distinguish it from the main residence without delay.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move directly between buildings on foot.
• Post the property address on both the main residence and the detached structure so responders working at the rear of the property can confirm their location.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored equipment or materials that would reduce the space available for emergency vehicles to stage or turn around.
• Identify and mark any side access points to the property, even if narrow, so responders are aware of secondary movement options around the structures.
• Keep any gates or barriers controlling side access unlocked or equipped with a combination that is shared with the local fire and emergency services.
